candidate.answerReason: Choice D equals 13579×2468, which exceeds 27158. Every other choice is less than 13580, so D is largest.

methods.label: Compare the effects of the operations
methods.explanation:
Since \(0<\frac1{2468}<1\), subtracting this fraction from \(13579\) or multiplying \(13579\) by it gives a number below \(13579\). Adding it gives a number below \(13580\), and \(13579.2468\) is also below \(13580\).

Dividing by a nonzero fraction means multiplying by its reciprocal. Therefore choice D is
\[
13579\div\frac1{2468}=13579\times2468
>13579\times2=27158.
\]
This exceeds every other choice, so the largest number is \(\boxed{13579\div\frac1{2468}}\), choice \(\mathrm{D}\).
